notes: VERIFIED against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/GLBH-ug.html and the department major page. Total 24 courses / 96 units. All courses applied to the major must earn a grade of C- or better. More science-intensive than the B.A.; adds a full year each of biology, general chemistry, and calculus. Structure, bucket counts, required core courses, and division classifications all corroborated by both sources. Elective category lists are the same approved lists as the B.A. (representative, not exhaustive). NOTE: UCSD public-health subject code changed from FMPH to PH effective Fall 2024 (PH 101/102/110 = FMPH 101/102/110).

buckets.label: Lower-division intro courses
buckets.note: Two courses from this list. PH 40 accepted by petition. GLBH 20 (Introduction to Global Health) strongly recommended as one of the two. List confirmed on department page.

buckets.label: Introductory biology sequence
buckets.note: All three required (one full year of biology). Confirmed on both sources.

buckets.label: General chemistry with lab
buckets.note: All four required (one year of general chemistry plus lab). Confirmed on both sources.

buckets.label: Mathematics: first calculus
buckets.note: One of these (MATH 10A or MATH 20A). Confirmed.

buckets.label: Mathematics: second calculus
buckets.note: One of these (MATH 10B or MATH 20B); take the sequence matching the first calculus course. Confirmed.

buckets.label: Statistics course
buckets.note: One of these to complete the math/statistics year requirement. Confirmed on both sources (B.S. stats options are narrower than the B.A.).

buckets.label: Upper-division Global Health core
buckets.note: All three required: GLBH 148 (Global Health and Cultural Diversity), GLBH 181 (Essentials of Global Health), MGT 173 (Project Management: Health Services). Confirmed on both sources.

buckets.label: Policy analysis course
buckets.note: One of these. USP 133 and SOCI 152 are cross-listed (same course). Same list as the B.A.; confirmed on catalog.

buckets.label: Global Health field experience
buckets.note: Non-course requirement (confirmed, identical to B.A.): minimum 100 hours over at least 5 weeks (3 weeks if international), distributed over no more than three programs, at an approved research, service, or clinical site, completed by graduation quarter. Culminates in a capstone seminar and senior thesis. Non-course experiential requirement, identical to the B.A. Minimum 100 field-experience hours over at least 5 weeks (3 weeks if international), distributed across no more than three programs, at an approved research, service, or clinical site, completed by the graduation quarter. Culminates in a capstone seminar and senior thesis. Not satisfied by any fixed course set, so classified manual. (The associated capstone/thesis is typically taken as GLBH 191/195-series units but the field hours themselves are the gating requirement and are verified/petitioned by the department.)

buckets.label: Biological science electives (upper-division)
buckets.note: 3 upper-division courses from the approved biological science list (B.S. requires all upper-division here). PH 101/102 = FMPH 101/102. Representative list, not exhaustive.

buckets.label: Medical social science electives (upper-division)
buckets.note: 4 upper-division courses from the approved medical social science list (B.S. requires one more than the B.A.). Also includes many GLBH 100-173 courses. PH 110 = FMPH 110. Representative list, not exhaustive.

buckets.label: Medical humanities elective (upper-division)
buckets.note: 1 upper-division course from the approved medical humanities list. Codes verified against catalog. Representative list, not exhaustive. (B.S. does not require the global-processes or significant-writing electives that the B.A. requires.)
